reason: The transition instrument measures the produced VSIX archive: vsce normalizes the three metadata names (README.md→readme.md, LICENSE→LICENSE.txt, CHANGELOG.md→changelog.md) and its ChangelogProcessor rewrites relative links and issue references during packaging, so the baseline adopts archive naming and packaged bytes. PR #11859 removes the withdrawn organize-imports contributions, shrinking package.json, package.nls.json, out/extension.js, and the packaged readme.md. The candidate baseline adopts the exact current-source archive inventory; platform bundle entries stay outside this baseline and are ignored by the instrument in current-source mode.
